observations: Photo 0: Black Xbox One X console with a black controller on top, placed on a blue glass table. The console has a visible 'X' logo on the front right. The background shows a blue cabinet with laptops and a sign that reads 'HILIFE STORES LTD'.

Photo 1: Same console and controller from a slightly different angle. The back of the console shows multiple ports, including HDMI and USB. A small white label is visible near the top right, but the text is not legible. The same blue cabinet and store sign are in the background.

Photo 2: Top-down view of the console with the controller on top. The console has a matte black finish with visible scratches and wear. The 'X' logo is visible on the front. The controller has the standard Xbox button layout (A, B, X, Y, D-pad, analog sticks).
All photos show the console and controller in a store environment with blue cabinets and promotional signage for 'HILIFE STORES LTD'.
No games, cables, or other accessories are visible in any photo.
The console appears to be in used condition with visible wear, including scratches on the top surface.

identity.kind: Xbox One X console with one controller

claims.claim: Uk used Microsoft Xbox One X 1TB storage
claims.evidence: The console is identifiable as an Xbox One X from the 'X' logo and design, but the storage capacity is not visible in any photo. The seller claims 1TB, but no label or screen confirms this.
One black controller is visible on top of the console in all three photos.
No games are visible in any photo. The claim cannot be verified from the images alone.
The console is displayed in a store environment with blue cabinets and 'HILIFE STORES LTD' signage in all photos.
Subjective claim; cannot be verified from photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be 1TB as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the console's label or screen showing storage capacity, or a video of the console booting up and showing the storage info.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-capacity model (e.g., 500GB) or as unverified capacity, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, booting up, and showing the Xbox dashboard or menu.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have damage
risks.proof: Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working controller, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Console may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console's ports, vents, and internal components, or a video showing the console's internal condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up, showing the Xbox dashboard or menu.
Photo or video of the console's label or screen showing the storage capacity (1TB).
Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.
Close-up photos of the console's ports, vents, and internal components.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
